subject.title: [Bug] openclaw doctor reports memory search disabled but memory-core dreaming is running — conflicting status

question: Should `openclaw doctor` own a stable cross-plugin dreaming-status summary, and if so which facts beyond enablement and schedule—such as last run and next run—are guaranteed enough to report?
rationale: The request crosses core doctor output, gateway diagnostics, and memory-core-owned runtime state; the desired operator contract cannot be selected safely from the closed unmerged proposals alone.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded diagnostic contract
options.body: Keep memory-search warnings intact and add a separate dreaming section using a small documented gateway payload for enabled state, phases, schedule, and only reliably available run metadata.

options.title: Keep doctor configuration-only
options.body: Limit doctor to explaining that dreaming is independent and direct users to `openclaw memory status --deep` for runtime details.

options.title: Defer richer runtime status
options.body: Avoid expanding the core doctor contract until memory-core exposes stable last-run and next-run facts through its owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded diagnostic contract
recommendation.body: Keep memory-search warnings intact and add a separate dreaming section using a small documented gateway payload for enabled state, phases, schedule, and only reliably available run metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work is the strongest supplied-history connection to the existing doctor memory-search and gateway-health diagnostic boundary.
